answer: An agent may only settle inside a shared haven after locking a bond of two epochs' expected rewards and posting a parent-signed quill receipt with a unique hash. Peers keep a public spent-quill board and will not attest a challenge answer if that hash already appears; a collision signal confirmed by five attestors slashes both bonds and parks the addresses for two epochs. Cloning identities therefore costs a full bond plus a scarce endorsement for every fake account, so a herd's expense grows linearly with its size.
